meta.name: Songhealth CMS Content Model
meta.description: Feature 002 seed intent for the existing canonical platform: defines the three shared native taxonomies — topic, audience and hierarchical area — and still defines zero Product collections, relations, menus, redirects, widgetAreas, sections and content, suppressing EmDash's built-in example Posts/Pages model. Term inventories are intentionally empty pending authoritative sources; no official terms, geographic codes or inventories are supplied. Taxonomy attachments are added as each owning collection is introduced. Area terms model the applicable Province → District → Subdistrict → Village hierarchy: explicit official/stable code in the native term slug, name in the native label, parent via native group identity.
